source: Notion DATATHON pages 8, 9, 10 and 'Estrategias para la final'; repo docs (model_architecture_decision.md, cycle_log.md, lgbm_cart_v2_2026-11-14.md); fz_adaptive/README.md. Times CET.

items.decision: Hard-ban products the shopper already bought
items.evidence: Live, already-bought items converted 0.007 % (1 purchase in ~24k impressions) vs 1.66 % in the 60-day history; ev-v1 gave 15 % of slots to them and scored 0.69 (< 0.75 baseline). After the ban ev-v2 scored 1.36.

items.decision: Judge arms with the official per-model leaderboard, not offline evaluators
items.evidence: All three offline evaluators rewarded re-buys; a local judge matched the leaderboard only without popularity features (Pearson 0.82 vs 0.43).

items.decision: One two-stage purchase ranker; retire skibidy and cf-rot; park exploration
items.evidence: lgbm-recent 1.48 (n=2,274) vs cf-rot 1.56 (n=753); 56-72 % of requests had several writers.

items.decision: Stop the local writer until on-time recovers
items.evidence: 1,102 answers: 107 push failures, 787 late; p95 13.5 s (RawTree endpoint timeouts).
Purchase AUC 0.904 but purchase NDCG -0.0445 vs logged order, 95 % CI [-0.107, +0.015], 81 purchases.

items.decision: Final: reliability first, one writer without shards, no exploration in slots 1-3, freeze before 10:00
items.evidence: ~15 % missing 14:15-17:25 CET; ~190 purchases expected in the final, so a 50/50 split only detects lifts above 26-40 %.

items.decision: fz-v9a ranks the whole catalogue: no category penalty, no boost, no diversity cap; online correction on
items.evidence: Same-category only 1.38 vs all 2.09; penalty x0.5 1.84 vs 2.09; diversity cap 1.42 vs 1.85; online correction 2.21 vs 2.17 (tie).

items.decision: Configuració de la final: fz-v10-nocorr (correcció online desactivada)
items.evidence: A/B nocturn de 3 h: 2,23 vs 2,15 compres/100 (fred 2,74 vs 2,59), 10.789 peticions. Commit 139e1c8 (Daniel).
